causal_limit: This is diagnostic and correlational. No paired image-level bootstrap confidence intervals, full corrected drift sweep, AP-tail quantiles, or branch-only image decomposition were run.

anomaly_score_state.evidence: No full corrected anomaly-score quantile audit was retained; bounded E14 peer delta statistics are mechanism diagnostics only.

checkpoint_stability.evidence: Both corrected runs have valid matched LR/scheduler states; target metrics still vary across E10-E20 and no full post-corrective drift battery was rerun.

cir_training_effect.evidence: C0-P is negative for Medical pixel AUROC and Pixel AP at every candidate epoch; C05 does not recover the gap.

classification_branch_state.evidence: IMAGE_BRANCH_AUDIT.csv: branch-only classification scores were not emitted by the frozen evaluator.

clipping_frequency.evidence: The clip norm is fixed at 1.0 and code path is audited, but per-step clipping frequency was not logged.

cls_seg_gradient_cosine.evidence: LOSS_GRADIENT_AUDIT.csv: corrected E14 classification/segmentation cosine +0.033898; no negative conflict in the bounded batch.

cls_seg_gradient_norm_ratio.evidence: Corrected E14 segmentation/classification total gradient norm ratio is 0.4266; this is a single-batch measurement, not a training-wide imbalance estimate.

cross_head_agreement_state.evidence: No separate classification-only versus pixel-max-only decomposition was run.

image_ap_state.evidence: C0 image AP is mixed: below P at E10/E12 and above P at E14-E20; Colon image metrics are undefined by evaluator contract.

image_auroc_state.evidence: C0 image AUROC exceeds P at all six unweighted macro epochs; the image branch is not the dominant observed gap.

loss_state.evidence: Loss formula is matched and finite; weighted KG is tiny and weighted K is exactly zero in the bounded E14 batch, but causal importance is unknown.

lr_schedule_state.evidence: parent_lr_history.csv and cir_lr_history.csv: StepLR states and all three post-step learning rates match at E10-E20.

mad_state.evidence: E14 Brain peer MAD has median 0.003865 and minimum 3.22e-6, exposing low-dispersion normalization risk.

normal_upper_tail_state.evidence: AP_TAIL_AUDIT.csv: corrected normal p99.9/top-k analysis was not run because exact spools were cleaned after scoring.

optimizer_state.evidence: CHECKPOINT_AUDIT.csv: all 12 candidate checkpoints finite with 113 optimizer-state entries and identical global-step schedule.

parent_source_quality.evidence: corrected_source_decomposition.csv: P source Pixel AUROC 0.9710-0.9763 and Pixel AP 0.5132-0.6339 across E10-E20.

parent_target_quality.evidence: corrected_medical_decomposition.csv: P six-target pixel macro AP 31.81-32.94%; target transfer remains difficult even for P.

peer_signal_state.evidence: POST_CORRECTIVE_PEER_SUMMARY.csv: peer validity/invariants pass, but C05-C0 score effect is negligible and post-hoc contamination is diagnostic-only.

pixel_ap_state.evidence: C0 Medical pixel AP trails P by 1.32-2.59 percentage points at macro level; Retina, ClinicDB, and Kvasir are especially weak.

pixel_auroc_state.evidence: C0 Medical pixel AUROC trails P by 0.69-1.96 percentage points at macro level, despite absolute AUROC remaining high.

pixel_branch_state.evidence: The residual corrected gap is concentrated in Medical pixel AUROC/AP, not the fused image metrics.

rank_signal_state.evidence: E14 Brain z statistics have extreme tails (p99 1300.84, max 99855.59); predictive utility was not established.

representation_drift_state.evidence: No full corrected E12->E20 representation-drift sweep was rerun; this snapshot preserves checkpoint identities and metric trajectories.

rmt_inference_effect.evidence: C05-C0 is near zero at every source and Medical macro epoch; maximum absolute Medical pixel effect is 0.0114 percentage points.

saturation_state.evidence: E14 Brain has |delta|>0.99 for 55.66% of diagnostic patches and |delta|>0.95 for 63.52%.

stage_consistency_state.evidence: STAGE_RELIABILITY_AUDIT.csv: E14 Brain stage 1 Pixel AP 0.4356 versus stage 0 0.0745 and stage 2 0.1023 on 60 diagnostic images.

train_deploy_consistency.evidence: DEPLOYMENT_CONSISTENCY_AUDIT.csv: E14 bounded batch mean absolute difference 0.0032489, maximum 0.9993287, Pearson 0.6475441.

interpretation: The corrected run removes the scheduler confound but does not make C0 medically pixel-matched to P. C05 is inference-neutral. A representation-preservation / target-transfer issue remains more supported than an inference-RMT win or a multitask-gradient bug.
